description: This file defines a set of mixins for creating caret (arrow) indicators in stylesheets, allowing for different directions and customizable properties.

methods.name: caret-down
methods.description: Creates a downward pointing caret with specified width.

methods.name: caret-up
methods.description: Creates an upward pointing caret with specified width.

methods.name: caret-end
methods.description: Creates a caret pointing to the end.

methods.name: caret-start
methods.description: Creates a caret pointing to the start.

methods.name: caret
methods.description: Main mixin to generate caret styles based on direction and other parameters.
